milestones.title: CrawlScan launch
milestones.text: CrawlScan goes live on Robinhood Chain: paste a Pons token and the crawlers reveal who really controls the supply, merging linked wallets into real operators.

milestones.title: Solana and pump.fun
milestones.text: Every pump.fun token on Solana can be scanned, with the chain detected automatically from the address.

milestones.title: Burns and holder rewards
milestones.text: $CrawlScan gets burns every 12 hours from the dev's own supply and a daily reward for one holder, all verifiable onchain.

milestones.title: Telegram bot
milestones.text: @CrawlScanBot brings the verdict to Telegram: send a contract and get the score, operators and dump risk in seconds.

milestones.title: Probably rug warning
milestones.text: Every result gets a live price chart, and DANGER setups show how deep the drop could go and which wallets are behind it.

milestones.title: Early buyers
milestones.text: The first 20 buyers after launch: how fast they got in, and whether they're still holding or already out.

milestones.title: Telegram alerts
milestones.text: Watch tokens in the bot and get a message when the verdict turns DANGER, a rug warning appears or the biggest holders start selling.

milestones.title: Flap launchpad
milestones.text: Flap tokens on Robinhood Chain, with bonding curve progress and buy and sell tax shown before you buy.

milestones.title: Operator memory
milestones.text: Every scan is now remembered, so the scanner builds its own history of the wallets behind memecoins and gets smarter every day.

milestones.title: Bankr launchpad
milestones.text: Bankr tokens on Robinhood Chain, with dev vesting and the real price impact read from the pool itself.

milestones.title: Rug Replay
milestones.text: A public record of tokens CrawlScan flagged DANGER that then fell 90% or more, with the market cap at the scan and after.
